propuesta.prompt: @image1 is a real photo of glazed salmon fillet over black rice at a modern Mediterranean bistro. Use it only as the list of elements, not as a layout to copy. The new photograph must contain the same real elements: the thick golden-glazed salmon fillet, glossy black rice with spinach, one orange purée quenelle topped with black flakes, fresh microgreens, bright green herb oil drizzle, in the exact off-white shallow ceramic bowl. Exactly one salmon fillet, one quenelle of orange purée, and one ceramic bowl. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: a low-angle 20-degree close-up shot, bowl anchored in the lower two-thirds of the vertical frame, 85 mm lens at f/2.8, creating ample dark clear space in the upper third for magazine-style typography, with the salmon glaze and texture sharply focused. Hard direct side flash creating a crisp shadow cast behind the dish against a dark green velvet backdrop, with vivid specular highlights on the glaze and oil, deep moody emerald green and black background with high-contrast orange salmon glaze accents. Photographic realism, no text.
